svg.title: Primary grades by site
svg.desc: Primary report for fictional sites S01 through S40. Student need is unresolved for all. Community grade 1 comprises S13, S14, S17, S18, S19, S20, S25, S26, S27 and S32. Grade 2 comprises S11, S12, S16, S23, S24, S29, S30, S31, S33 and S34. The remaining 20 sites have grade 3.

g.text: 40 fictional sites in their original ID order
Lower grade numbers indicate higher reported community need.
